params.body: After #188 the Stocklist render is 27 queries and 80 ms database, but 400 ms app. To see where the PHP goes, App\Support\Timing books named segments (mark/measure) that the ServerTiming middleware appends to the header for administrators. The StocklistBrowser render is marked in five steps: before_render (boot, hydration), facets_and_histograms, search, card_relations, rest_of_render; what remains up to app is the Blade view and Livewire's dehydration.
params.title: Server-Timing: named segments, Stocklist render instrumented
